entries.tactical_failure_mode_quoted: The signature failure is treating the reframing as a mechanical wrapper: taking an established attribution, decomposition, or estimation tool and pointing it at a new input granularity, a new architecture, or a new domain without re-deriving why the resulting scores are faithful to the model. These papers supply the computation but not the justification — no causal validation that the identified components actually drive behavior (only correlation), no axiomatic or soundness argument for why the proposed definition is the 'real' importance, and no confound control, so a reviewer can point to a methodological artifact (a computation-granularity difference, a degenerate zero baseline, an off-manifold perturbation) that explains the result instead.

entries.tactical_failure_mode_quoted: Papers attempting this tactic fail most often when the constructed instrument isolates the confound only inside an artificial regime and never demonstrates that the isolated signal transfers to real deployment conditions — the synthetic-to-real gap is asserted rather than shown. A second recurring shape is circularity: the diagnostic is validated against the same definition, assumption, or system population it was built to interrogate (using the evaluated models as their own oracle, or hardcoding a contested definition of the target property), so it cannot independently confirm what it claims.

reject_lessons_evaluated.lesson_quoted: A diagnostic that only re-confirms a shortcut already known in advance, surfacing no previously unmeasurable failure, is read as confirmatory rather than as a contribution.
reject_lessons_evaluated.reasoning: The headline claim concerns the cost and error of adaptive adoption decisions, not merely re-confirming that artifact-conditioned tasks can inflate utility.

reject_lessons_evaluated.lesson_quoted: Validating a synthetic-ground-truth instrument only on synthetic data, without demonstrating that the controlled finding transfers to real-world instances, leaves ecological validity unestablished and undermines the central claim.
reject_lessons_evaluated.reasoning: The planned replay uses eight locked real-reuse cases and full paired reproductions rather than synthetic-only ground truth.

reject_lessons_evaluated.lesson_quoted: Building the instrument around one contested definition of the target property means it cannot independently confirm that the definition is correct, and reviewers flag the resulting circularity.

reject_lessons_evaluated.lesson_quoted: Resting an unsupervised evaluation on the unverified premise that the systems under test can reliably judge one another stakes the entire method on an assumption that collapses under scrutiny.

entries.tactical_pattern_quoted: This cluster recasts an opaque transparency question about an already-trained model or dataset — which feature/datum/internal component is responsible, how uncertain a prediction is, what a hidden representation encodes — as a concrete measurement over a well-studied object: a manifold-constrained counterfactual optimization, a submodular subset selection, an expectation/estimator over marginal statistics, an additive decomposition into a (often sparse) basis, or an influence/Shapley score accumulated along the optimization trajectory. The decisive move is choosing the right unit of analysis and the right faithfulness constraint so the resulting scores reflect the model's actual computation rather than an off-distribution or post-hoc artifact — e.g., searching counterfactuals only on the learned data manifold, decomposing into monosemantic sparse directions before causal tracing, or embedding the explanatory predictors as the primary decision representation.
entries.instantiation_in_core_mechanism: No core_mechanism step produces a per-unit responsibility or uncertainty score about a fixed model or dataset, supplies the cluster's compression move, or certifies such an attribution by perturbation/proof; steps 5-8 instead instantiate generic cost-sensitive Bayesian experimental design over probe outcomes.

entries.tactical_pattern_quoted: The shared move is to construct a controlled set of evaluation instances in which exactly one named confound is either structurally blocked or independently varied, then report the divergence between apparent and de-confounded performance as the primary result rather than an aggregate leaderboard score. The confounds attacked are recurring and specific — memorization/contamination, surface style, the generating source's capability, single-modality shortcuts, scoring-function nonlinearity, and task-format exposure — and the load-bearing artifact is always the controlled instance set paired with an oracle independent of the system under test.

paper_pointed_threat.subsumption_argument: The retrieved abstract-level hit already combines a user utility over performance and cost, a cost-sensitive acquisition rule that selects the next fidelity by expected future utility, and automatic stopping near the utility optimum. EDIV_t(q) is the same central sequential value-of-information mechanism expressed as expected Bayes decision-risk reduction per unit cost; changing the application object from configuration fidelities to heterogeneous paper probes, and changing the terminal utility to an adoption-sign loss, does not create a new acquisition principle. The degraded collision coverage prevents any claim that this is the only ancestor, but it does not weaken this positive exact-mechanism overlap.
paper_pointed_threat.parametric_family_concern: Bayesian optimal experimental design and cost-sensitive active sequential hypothesis testing; a scoop-check should query 'expected Bayes risk reduction per unit cost' and 'active sequential hypothesis testing stopping rule'.
